# Custom Migration: VideoTask Active Unique Index

**Phase:** 3D-2B1
**Date:** 2026-06-26
**Type:** Manual (not generated by `prisma migrate dev`)

## Purpose

PostgreSQL partial unique index that prevents duplicate active VideoTasks
for the same `(prompt_id, provider)` combination.

## Why Not `@@unique` in schema.prisma?

`@@unique([promptId, provider])` would prevent ALL duplicates — including
historical completed/failed tasks. That would block legitimate re-submission
of a prompt after a previous attempt failed or completed.

This partial index only enforces uniqueness for **active** tasks.

## Prisma Awareness

This index is NOT represented in `schema.prisma` via `@@unique`.
Prisma `db push` will NOT create or drop it.
Prisma `migrate dev` will NOT generate a conflicting `@@unique`.

A comment in `schema.prisma` on the `VideoTask` model documents its existence
to prevent accidental removal by future developers.

## Rollback

```sql
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS "VideoTask_active_prompt_provider_key";
```
